newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul to ease borrowing rules for foreign firms.
newsitem.headline: Seoul to ease borrowing rules for foreign firms.

text.p: South Korea's finance and economy ministry said on Tuesday it would allow locally-based foreign manufacturers to freely borrow from abroad if the money was to be used for their operations.
The new rule will come into effect from July 14. But the maturity of the overseas borrowings cannot exceed five years, the ministry said in a statement.
But the amount should be within a limit of either 50 percent of total investment by the foreign manufacturer or within $10 million.
At present, the government limits overseas borrowings by foreign companies to finance imports of foreign goods .
